summary.text: April Connors is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 8-Position 2, which she has represented since January 9, 2023, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Connors earned a bachelor's degree from Washington State University in 1990 and works as a real estate broker.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a local real estate professional of 22 years.
She has been affiliated with the Kadlec Foundation Board.
Connors succeeded Matt Boehnke (R) in the District 8-Position 2 seat in 2023.
She won the 2024 general election over John Christenson (D), 70.4% to 29.4%.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Appropriations, Consumer Protection & Business, and Housing committees.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary and appears on the November ballot without a listed opponent.
